dz: 英国教会向英格兰国王呈递了一次集会,会上放弃了一些权利,例如使省教会的法律独立于国王.
de: The English church submits to the king of England in passing a convocation in which it surrenders a number of rights, such as to make provincial ecclesiastic laws independently of the king.

t: 托马斯·莫尔爵士辞去英国大法官职务.
te: Sir Thomas More resigns as Lord Chancellor of England.
dz: 托马斯·莫尔爵士辞去英国大法官职务.
de: Sir Thomas More resigns as Lord Chancellor of England.

dz: 英国亨利八世与法国弗朗索瓦一世签署《法国更亲和条约》（又称波美拉耶条约），承诺互助对抗神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理五世。
de: Henry VIII of England and Francis I of France sign the "Treaty of Closer Amity With France" (also known as the Pommeraye treaty), pledging mutual aid against Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor.

t: 布列塔尼公国被吸收入法兰西王国.
te: The Duchy of Brittany is absorbed into the Kingdom of France.
dz: 布列塔尼与法国联盟:布列塔尼公国被吸收入法兰西王国.
de: Union of Brittany and France: The Duchy of Brittany is absorbed into the Kingdom of France.

t: 安妮·博林女士被她的未婚夫英国国王亨利八世封为彭布罗克侯爵。
te: Lady Anne Boleyn is made Marquess of Pembroke by her fiancé, King Henry VIII of England.
dz: 安妮·博林女士被她的未婚夫英国国王亨利八世封为彭布罗克侯爵。
de: Lady Anne Boleyn is made Marquess of Pembroke by her fiancé, King Henry VIII of England.

te: Commanded by Francisco Pizarro, Spanish conquistadors under Hernando de Soto meet Incan Emperor Atahualpa for the first…
dz: 西班牙征服印加帝国:由弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗指挥,埃尔南多·德·索托手下的西班牙征服者在卡哈马卡外与因坎皇帝阿塔胡阿帕相会,于次日安排在市广场相会.
de: Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire: Commanded by Francisco Pizarro, Spanish conquistadors under Hernando de Soto meet Incan Emperor Atahualpa for the first time outside Cajamarca, arranging for a meeting in the city plaza the following day.

t: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗和手下在卡哈马尔卡战役中俘虏了印加皇帝阿塔胡尔帕.
te: Francisco Pizarro and his men capture Inca Emperor Atahualpa at the Battle of Cajamarca.
dz: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗和手下在卡哈马尔卡战役中俘虏了印加皇帝阿塔胡尔帕.
de: Francisco Pizarro and his men capture Inca Emperor Atahualpa at the Battle of Cajamarca.
